tool.hint.select: Click an object to select it. Shift + click adds to the selection.
tool.hint.line_locked: Locked to {0}. Click or type a length. {1}
tool.hint.lock_change: An arrow key changes the lock.
tool.hint.lock_release: The same arrow key releases the lock.
tool.hint.line_next: Click the next point or type a length. Right/Left/Up arrow: X/Y/Z axis, Down: perpendicular to the plane. 30d: slant 30°. Esc: finish.
tool.hint.rect_second: Click the opposite corner or type the size, e.g. 5;4.
tool.hint.cloud_move_dest: Click the destination: a point, edge, face, axis, or the origin. Or type a distance. Arrows: lock axis. Esc cancels.
tool.hint.cloud_move_ref: Click a reference point, anywhere. That point will be placed at the destination.
tool.hint.cloud_move_pick: Click a point on the cloud. That point will be placed at the destination.
tool.hint.cloud_slice_second: Click the opposite corner. The box height follows the whole cloud.
tool.hint.cloud_slice_hold: Move the side of the box, then click. Esc cancels.
tool.hint.cloud_slice_shown: Click the marker at the middle of a side to move it. Show all is in the right panel.
tool.hint.cloud_slice_first: Click the first corner of the area to view, easiest from the top view.
tool.hint.pushpull_keep: Click a face: it becomes a new solid and the original stays. Ctrl or C cancels.
tool.hint.pushpull_pick: Click a region or face. Shift+click: pick several. Ctrl or C: make a new solid from a face.
tool.hint.pushpull_height: Click a height or type a distance. Shift+click: add another face.
tool.hint.move_dest: Click the destination or type a distance. Arrows: lock axis.
tool.hint.rotate_pick: Click an object: that point becomes the pivot.
tool.hint.rotate_zero: Click the zero direction. Arrows: rotation axis.
tool.hint.scale_factor: Move the cursor then click, or type a factor.
tool.hint.paint: Click a face to paint it. Pick the color in the top row.
tool.hint.erase: Click an edge to erase it.
tool.hint.round_center: Click the center. 8s: number of sides.
tool.hint.arc_height: Click or type the arc height.
tool.hint.tape_start: Click an edge for a guide line, or a point for a guide point.
tool.hint.tape_move: Move the cursor away, then click or type a distance.
tool.hint.follow_profile: Click a region or face as the profile.
tool.hint.follow_path: Click a line as the path.
error.out_of_tile: Refused: the result is {0} m from the tile center (limit {1} m)
error.out_of_project: Refused: outside the project bounds (±{0} m from the origin)
error.out_of_scope: Outside what is being edited. Contents of a group or component: double-click to enter. Esc leaves again.
error.object_no_contents: a plain object has no contents
error.draw_across_group: drawing on a plane that holds a drawing on the other side of a group boundary
error.follow_face_only: Follow Me on anything but a face
error.not_group_or_component: what is selected is not a group or component
error.pushpull_face_only: Push/Pull on anything but a face
error.pushpull_one_tile: Push/Pull on several targets must stay in one tile
error.new_solid_face_only: a new solid only comes from a solid's face; a region already becomes a new solid without Ctrl
error.cloud_too_far: the cloud was moved too far
error.rename_many: renaming more than one object at once
error.edit_many: editing the contents of more than one object at once
error.bad_rotation_axis: the rotation axis is not valid
error.line_needs_length: a line needs a length (2.5) or an angle (30d)
error.rect_needs_sizes: a rectangle needs two sizes, e.g. 5;4
error.rotate_needs_angle: rotating needs an angle in degrees; after copying, x5
error.scale_needs_factor: scaling needs one factor, e.g. 2 or 0.5
error.scale_positive: the scale factor must be positive
error.sides_out_of_range: the number of sides is out of range (a circle needs at least 24)
error.round_needs: click the center, then type a radius, or 8s for the sides
error.click_arc_ends: click the two ends of the arc first
error.arc_needs_height: an arc needs one arc height
error.click_region_first: click a region or face first
error.tape_click_start: click the start point, then move the cursor
error.tape_needs_distance: the tape measure needs one distance
error.tape_zero: the tape measure distance must not be zero
error.follow_click_profile: click a region or face as the profile
error.follow_click_path: click a line as the path
error.follow_same_tile: the profile and the path must be in the same tile
error.move_needs_distance: Move needs one distance; after copying, x5 or /5
error.paint_solid_only: paint only works on a solid's face; pull the region into a solid first
error.click_cloud_point: click a point on the cloud
error.click_cloud_point_first: click a point on the cloud first
error.cloud_move_needs_distance: moving a cloud needs one distance, e.g. 3
error.slice_by_click: the slice box is set by clicking, not by numbers
error.click_face_first: click a face or region first
error.distance_zero: the distance must not be zero
error.no_matching_face: another selected object has no face facing the same way; groups and components are edited through Edit contents
error.face_not_found: the face of the selected object was not found
menu.save_tip: Saves to the open file. A new project asks where.
menu.save_as_tip: One tile becomes .hew, several tiles become .wangun.
menu.export_tip: Writes the model to .obj, .glb, .gltf, .stl, or .3mf. The project does not change.
menu.import_cloud_tip: Loads a .las as a reference. Only the points that need to be visible are loaded.
paint.label: Paint:
status.split: Split into {0} kernel tiles of 1 km
status.guide_made: Guide created: a pink line, snapping sticks to it.
error.save_exists: {0} already exists and is not the file being edited. Use Save as with another name.
error.save_clouds_failed: The project was saved, but the point cloud list was not: {0}
error.no_cache_dir: The user folder is unknown, so there is nowhere to keep the cache.
error.bad_export_name: The file name must end with one of: {0}.
error.export_multi_tile: This format is only for single-tile projects. Use .obj.
error.export_nothing: There is no solid to export.
error.no_file_window: The file window cannot be opened. Install xdg-desktop-portal or zenity.
error.mesh_failed: Failed to build the mesh of tile {0}: {1}
error.pick_first: Select an object first with Select (Space).
cloud.remove_tip: From the project only. The LAS file is not deleted.
cloud.move_tip: Click a reference point, then its destination. Snaps to anything.
cloud.reset_tip: Back to its original coordinates in the LAS.
cloud.offset: Moved {0}, {1}, {2} m from the LAS coordinates
cloud.budget_tip: Lower it if camera movement feels heavy.
cloud.show_all_tip: Shows the points outside the box. The box is still remembered.
cloud.slice_hint: Use Slice area (K) to see one area only.
cloud.crs_mismatch: {0} uses EPSG:{1}, the project uses EPSG:{2}. Reprojection is not supported yet.
cloud.note_no_origin: The project has no origin yet: the model stays in local coordinates, the cloud's center is at zero.
cloud.note_no_crs: The LAS names no CRS: its coordinates are used as they are.
cloud.note_offset_ignored: The cloud offset in the companion file is outside the project bounds, so it is ignored.
error.las_unreadable: The LAS file cannot be read or is damaged: {0}
error.las_empty: The LAS file holds no points.
error.las_truncated: The LAS point data is cut short: {0} of {1} points. Copy the source file again.
error.las_bad_coords: The LAS file holds invalid coordinates.
error.cloud_io: The point cloud file cannot be read or written: {0}
error.cloud_cache: The point cloud cache is damaged; import the LAS file again.
error.las_panicked: The LAS reader stopped unexpectedly; check the source file.
dialog.recover_text: There is an autosave from a session that did not end normally.
dialog.unsaved_text: The latest changes are not saved.
format.filter_obj_multi: Wavefront OBJ (.obj), the only one for several tiles
format.hew: Single-tile project: geometry, colors, tags, names, groups, components.
format.wangun: Multi-tile project, same contents. Made automatically when a project has more than one tile.
format.obj: All tiles. No colors. Project-local coordinates, the origin is written in a comment.
format.las: LAS point cloud 1.0 to 1.4, no LAZ. Becomes a reference for drawing. Does not change the model and is not exported.
